item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We should prepare now to use its capabilities to serve the public better.

2. We believe superintelligent AI, if built within the next 20 years, will make every government more effective. That means stronger public services, better decisions and governments better able to meet people’s needs.

3. Superintelligent AI will make every government more effective if it arrives within the next 20 years. We should start building the institutions and safeguards that help governments put that power to work for everyone.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

We believe superintelligent AI, if built within the next 20 years, will make every government more effective. That conviction shapes how we think about the future of public service. Governments that can make better decisions, deliver services more efficiently and respond more capably to people’s needs can improve daily life on a vast scale. The opportunity is not automatic: public institutions will need the knowledge, capacity and sound practices to put powerful AI to work responsibly. We should start preparing now, with clear goals and a focus on the public good. The choices we make today can help ensure governments are ready to use tomorrow’s capabilities to serve everyone better.
